reviewer: Computational AI annotator; not human or specialist review.
independence_limits: Later imagery and prior Camera 2 research are familiar. This proposal inspected only baseline f6593 and its new labeled derivatives. No later frame was opened or scored for selection. Shared seeds are known; a subsequent baseline re-localization is not independent baseline construction.
coordinate_convention: Zero-based native stored pixel centers; origin upper-left; x right, y down.
uncertainty_definition: Subjective rectangular localization envelope in native encoded pixels; not a confidence interval, survey accuracy or calibrated physical error.

targets.description: Apparent image-right outer upper corner of the large target facade, at the end of the lower of its two visible upper-outline segments.
targets.point_type: Apparent silhouette corner: estimated intersection of upper and exterior side boundaries.
targets.point_definition: Localize the corner where the short, nearly horizontal lower upper-outline segment meets the long near-vertical image-right exterior boundary of the target. Use the center of the blurred dark-to-light corner transition, not the brightest halo pixel, a nearby smoke edge or a lower foreground roof corner.
targets.baseline_visual_association: The red hollow marker in baseline-target-markers.png surrounds the visible outer upper corner; native and coordinate crops show both participating boundary segments.
targets.material_identity_caveat: These are projected appearance boundaries, not authenticated material edges or a surveyed corner. Blur, bright halo, smoke/background changes, perspective and overlap can shift the apparent intersection. Exact facade orientation, building component, structural member and persistent material identity are not assigned.
targets.continuity_rule: Follow this defined target outer-corner appearance only while identifiable; do not substitute a foreground-building corner or smoke boundary. A localized changed silhouette must retain changed or uncertain correspondence, rather than automatically becoming the same point.

targets.description: Upper endpoint of the short downward step in the target's upper outline, image-left of C2-T1.
targets.point_type: Apparent stepped-silhouette corner: upper endpoint of the short descending boundary.
targets.point_definition: Localize the corner where the higher, long upper-outline segment ends and turns into the short near-vertical downward step. This is the UPPER endpoint near (424,144), not the lower junction near the lower upper-outline segment or an arbitrary point on the horizontal roof edge.
targets.baseline_visual_association: The blue hollow marker in baseline-target-markers.png surrounds the upper end of the short outlined step; the separate lower junction is visible below it and is not this target.
targets.material_identity_caveat: A raised outline is visible, but no penthouse, roof component, cardinal direction, structural member or material-point identity is authenticated here. Overlapping projections, smoke, blur and deformation can change or remove this corner. A subsequent nearby lower corner can be precisely localized without being a continuation of T2.
targets.continuity_rule: If this upper step endpoint can no longer be distinguished, retain ambiguous or unavailable localization as appropriate; do not silently relabel the lower junction or a replacement silhouette as T2. Localization and correspondence must be recorded separately.

third_point_decision: No C2-T3 proposed. The image-left upper transition is smoke-softened and the adjacent exterior boundary is not sufficiently distinct for this reviewer to identify a separable corner from the baseline alone. No uniquely defined target facade landmark was selected to fill a quota.
geometry_limit: Both proposed points occupy the image-right upper-outline region and are only 30 native pixels apart horizontally and 12 vertically. They do not sample the full facade width or depth and cannot support whole-building rigid motion, symmetry or tilt claims by themselves.

derivatives.transformation: Exact mode-L crop [280,115,470,200), size 190x85; no resize or contrast change.

Same crop enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor to 760x340, RGB only for display composition, pasted at (30,25) in an 800x415 white canvas with exterior source-coordinate ticks and explicit analytical labels. No point overlays, contrast adjustment or inferred detail.

Separate copy of labeled coordinate crop with red T1 and blue T2 hollow crosshair markers and coordinate text; the exact selected source-pixel display block remains uncovered. Proposal aid only, not historical evidence.

derivative_runtime: Explicit Python 3.13.7 interpreter; Pillow 12.0.0, verified from the actual generating command.
next_gate: Root independently checks and freezes accepted definitions before either analyst opens the evaluation set for this task. Each analyst then records localization and correspondence separately, including an independently re-estimated baseline coordinate/envelope, without seeing the other's new coordinates. This proposal does not begin evaluation.
